questions.question: Explain why 2/8 + 3/8 is 5/8 and not 5/16, using a chocolate slab.
questions.expected_answer: A slab of 8 blocks: 2 blocks plus 3 blocks is 5 blocks, and the slab still has 8 blocks altogether, so the answer is five eighths. The bottom number names the size of the pieces, which does not change when you add them.

questions.question: Three fifths of a class walk to school. What fraction does not walk? Explain using one whole.
questions.expected_answer: The whole class is five fifths. Three fifths walk, and three fifths plus two fifths is five fifths, so two fifths do not walk.

questions.question: Add 3/4 and 3/4 and write the answer as wholes and parts.
questions.expected_answer: 3/4 + 3/4 = 6/4. Four quarters make one whole, leaving 2 quarters, so the answer is 1 whole and 2 quarters, which is one and a half.
